user.title: Parcel Tracker
user.description: The DHL API key is optional: without it, DHL parcels come from the DHL mails via the mail import; with it you get the live status (place, history, time window). The key is free at developer.dhl.com (API "Shipment Tracking – Unified") and can be added later. The postcode (optional, e.g. 10115) lets DHL return more details and GLS the tracking history.

data_description.country: Decides how many digits the postcode has and which GLS lookup is asked.
data_description.postcode: Germany: 5 digits (e.g. 10115). Austria and Switzerland: 4 digits (e.g. 1010).

reauth_confirm.title: DHL API key rejected
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a valid DHL API key.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach DHL. Try again later.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Parcel Tracker is already set up.

create_entry.default: Reload the page once, then add the “Paket Tracker” card to your dashboard.

data_description.country: Decides how many digits the postcode has and which GLS lookup is asked.
data_description.postcode: Germany: 5 digits (e.g. 10115). Austria and Switzerland: 4 digits (e.g. 1010).
data_description.dhl_api_key: Without a key, DHL parcels come from the DHL mails via the mail import; with it you get the live status. Leave empty to keep the saved key.
data_description.track17_api_key: Free key from api.17track.net (200 numbers once). Only used when you ask for it on the card. Leave empty to keep the saved key.
data_description.hide_names: Parcels are only named after the carrier (e.g. “DHL-Paket”, “Amazon-Bestellung”) – on the card, in the calendar, in the sensors and in the notifications. For gifts on a shared dashboard. A name you typed in yourself stays visible; the stored names are not changed.

mail.name: Mail import (optional)
mail.description: Reads parcel mails from a dedicated mailbox via IMAP. Only enter a mailbox that receives nothing but parcel mails – never your main mailbox.

data.plain_names: Take sender names from DHL mails without the check

data_description.mail_enabled: Switching it off removes the saved username and password.
data_description.imap_port: Usual ports: 993 encrypted, 143 unencrypted. Choosing another connection does not change the port.
data_description.imap_security: "Encrypted (TLS, default)" fits every mail provider. The other two are only for a mail server in your own network, e.g. a self-hosted server with a self-signed certificate: with a provider on the internet the password could be read or the server impersonated.
data_description.imap_user: Leave empty to keep the saved username.
data_description.imap_password: Leave empty to keep the saved password.
data_description.imap_folder: The folder of the mailbox that is read – only this one. Keep "INBOX" for a dedicated parcel mailbox. A folder of your main mailbox works too, but then Home Assistant knows the password of that whole mailbox. Leave empty to keep the stored folder.
data_description.delete_processed_days: Permanently deletes mails in the folder Paket-Tracker-Verarbeitet once they are this many days old (arrival date), at most once a day. Only this folder, never the folder read and never Paket-Tracker-Nicht-erkannt. Works only with “Move processed mails to folders”. 0 = off.
data_description.read_otp: The card shows a code only after a tap and a confirmation. It never goes into the history.
data_description.plain_names: A DHL subject “Ihre … Sendung …” names the parcel after the name in it, also for a small shop or a private person. Names of private people can then show up on the card, in the calendar, in the sensors and in the notifications. Off by default. “Hide names” still wins: it shows only the carrier name.

ups.name: UPS live status (optional)
ups.description: Asks the official UPS Track API for UPS parcels. Create an app with the product "Tracking" on developer.ups.com and enter its Client ID and Secret. Without them, UPS parcels come from mails only.

data_description.ups_enabled: Switching it off removes the saved Client ID and secret.
data_description.ups_client_id: Leave empty to keep the saved Client ID.
data_description.ups_client_secret: Leave empty to keep the saved secret.
data_description.ups_monthly_budget: 0–10000. When used up, UPS parcels come from mails only until the month ends. 0 switches the API off.

notify.name: Notifications (optional)
notify.description: Sends a notification to the chosen targets when a parcel changes its status – no automation needed. The text only names the parcel, the carrier and the status; the delivery code, the full tracking number and addresses are never part of it.

data_description.notify_enabled: Switches itself on with the first target. Switching it off removes the chosen targets.
data_description.notify_targets: Notify entities (e.g. the Home Assistant app on your phone) and classic notify services such as Pushover, listed as “Dienst notify.…”. Without a target nothing is sent.
data_description.notify_events: The status changes you are notified about.

gift.name: Gift mode (optional)
gift.description: Who may see what is inside a gift.

data_description.gift_viewers: Only these people see what is inside a parcel in gift mode. Wall tablets and children's phones need a user of their own in Home Assistant.

persons.title: Persons
persons.description: Pick a person to set up their addresses and notifications. Parcels whose mail names no person or several persons belong to the choice below.

data_description.configured_person: Change or remove a person set up here, also one no longer in Home Assistant.
data_description.person: Set up a new person. Leave both empty to only save the fields below.
data_description.default_owner: Everyone (as before) or one of the persons set up here.
data_description.shared_addresses: Addresses that belong to several persons, e.g. family@… Parcels to these addresses belong to everyone.

data_description.addresses: The person's own mail address, their forwarding address (e.g. parcels+name@…) or the sender address when forwarding by hand. To remove all addresses, remove the person.
data_description.notify_targets: Notifications about this person's parcels only go here. Empty: to the general targets.
data_description.remove: Removes the addresses and notifications of this person.

dhl_auth.title: DHL API key rejected
dhl_auth.description: DHL no longer accepts the API key. Open the Parcel Tracker integration and enter a new key.

carrier_broken.title: {carrier} tracking not working
carrier_broken.description: Every {carrier} request failed for 24 hours. The carrier may have changed its website. Check for an update of Parcel Tracker.

imap_auth.title: Parcel mailbox login rejected
imap_auth.description: The mail server no longer accepts the login for the parcel mailbox. Open the Parcel Tracker options and enter the current password.

imap_insecure.title: Parcel mailbox is read without verified encryption
imap_insecure.description: The parcel mailbox is read without verified encryption (connection "Encrypted, don't verify the certificate" or "Unencrypted"), and the mail server doesn't look like one in your own network. The password could be read or the server impersonated on the way – use these connections only in your own network. Choose "Encrypted (TLS, default)" in the Parcel Tracker options. If the server is in your own network after all, you can ignore this notice.

amazon_unrecognized.title: Amazon mails not recognised
amazon_unrecognized.description: Parcel Tracker couldn't read the last 5 Amazon mails. Amazon may have changed its mail layout. Check for an update of Parcel Tracker; mails from the mailbox are in the folder Paket-Tracker-Nicht-erkannt.

ups_auth.title: UPS credentials rejected
ups_auth.description: UPS no longer accepts the Client ID or Secret. Open the Parcel Tracker options and check them. Until then UPS parcels come from mails only.

ups_budget.title: UPS monthly budget used up
ups_budget.description: Parcel Tracker used all UPS requests allowed for this month. UPS parcels come from mails only until the month ends; this notice disappears on the 1st. Raise the budget in the options if needed.

track17_auth.title: 17track API key rejected
track17_auth.description: 17track no longer accepts the API key. Parcel Tracker makes no 17track requests until you enter a valid key in the options or reload the integration.

track17_quota_low.title: 17track quota almost used up
track17_quota_low.description: Only {remain} of your 17track numbers are left. Each parcel you send to 17track uses one; parcels already sent keep updating.

track17_quota_exhausted.title: 17track quota used up
track17_quota_exhausted.description: All 17track numbers are used. New parcels can't be sent to 17track; parcels already sent keep updating.

card_resource_yaml.title: Add the Paket Tracker card to the dashboard resources
card_resource_yaml.description:
The dashboard resources are managed in YAML, so Parcel Tracker cannot add its card by itself. Add this entry (replacing an older `/local/parcel_tracker/…` entry, if there is one) under `lovelace:` → `resources:` in configuration.yaml and restart Home Assistant:

```yaml
- url: {url}
  type: module
```

This notice disappears once the card is listed there.

carrier.name: Carrier
carrier.description: auto, dhl, dpd, gls, hermes, ups or other (via 17track, needs a 17track API key).

owner.name: Owner
owner.description: Optional: the person the parcel belongs to (a person set up under Persons, such as person.anna, or all for everybody).

mark_delivered.name: Mark as received
mark_delivered.description: Mark a parcel as received by hand: it counts as delivered from now on and stays so. For orders without a delivery mail and parcels whose "delivered" never arrives.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Poll now, including the mailbox if configured.

set_gift.name: Mark as gift
set_gift.description: Mark a parcel, or all parcels not delivered yet, as a gift, or make it visible again (marking is open to everyone, only making it visible again is limited to people who may see gifts).

number.name: Tracking number
number.description: Parcel to change. Leave empty when choosing all open parcels.

open_parcels.name: All open parcels
open_parcels.description: Change every parcel that is not delivered yet instead of one.

gift.name: Gift
gift.description: On marks as gift, off makes it visible again.

gift_for.name: Gift for
gift_for.description: Persons the gift is for: they do not see it like someone who may see gifts, get no notification about it and cannot change it. Only with Gift on; an empty list removes the persons.

set_owner.name: Set owner
set_owner.description: Hand a parcel to a person, or to everybody. A mail never changes an owner set this way.

person.name: Person
person.description: A person set up under Persons (person.…) or all

track_17track.name: Track via 17track
track_17track.description: Send a parcel to 17track to add place, time window and history. Uses 1 of your 17track numbers.
